body.name: \(\mathfrak M_{p,m}^{\mathrm{CA}}\)
body.construction: \(\mathfrak M_{p,m}^{\mathrm{CA}}=\{(P,B^0,\varepsilon,\Gamma,\pi_0):p\ge2,\ m\ge2,\ (P,B^0,\varepsilon,\Gamma,\pi_0)\text{ satisfies every member property listed below}\}\). No Gaussianity restriction is imposed on \(P\) or on the generating disturbances \(\varepsilon\).
